title: Jab Tak Loha Garam Hai 🔥
hook_line: Garm loha peet, thanda peetne ko waqt bahutera paada hai.
caption:
Jab tak mauka saamne hai, tab tak mehnat karni hogi. 🔨

Harivansh Rai Bachchan ki ye lines humein yaad dilati hain ki sahi waqt par liya gaya faisla aur lagatar ki gayi mehnat hi safalta ka rasta hai. Kya aap bhi apne sapno ke liye 'garam loha' peet rahe hain? Bataiye niche! 👇

Save this for your daily motivation.
meaning_note: Ye poem 'hustle' aur sahi waqt par action lene ki taqat ko dikhati hai—ki jab mauka (loha) garam ho, tabhi uspar kaam karna chahiye.
